why_c_is_proposed: Observed failures split into (1) structural duties the model performed unreliably and (2) semantic judgments that were sometimes correct and sometimes false rejections. C assigns (1) to local code, including conservative presegmentation from B, and leaves (2) to the model. This is an evidential partition, not a Terra result.
